label: Image graph (related images)
description: One image in the middle and its RELATED images drawn out around it on fine connecting lines -- visual search, 'more like this', a web of sources behind an answer. The centre lands first, the others slide out from behind it as the lines draw to them, then they float gently. Full-frame; centre at x/y. Example: {"center":"/assets/.../bag.jpg","nodes":["...","...","...","...","...","..."],"at":0.3}.

nodes.label: Related image URLs (up to 12; 5-8 reads best)

nodes_at.label: When the related images start sliding out (default at + 0.6)

size.label: Centre tile width, fraction of the frame width (default 0.075)

radius.label: How far out they sit, fraction of the width (default 0.2)

float.label: Gentle drift after they land (default true)
